alchemist.description: When I roll a 1 or 2 for my main move, I can move 4 instead.

baba-yaga.description: Trip any racer that stops on my space, or when I stop on theirs.
baba-yaga.notes: If I share a space with Duelist, we can duel, but Duelist still trips. Hypnotist can warp me to their space, but they still trip.

banana.description: I trip any racer that passes me.

blimp.description: When I start my turn before the second corner of the track, I get +3 to my main move. On or after that corner, I get -1.

centaur.description: When I pass a racer, they move backwards 2.
centaur.notes: A racer cannot be pushed back farther than the Start space.

cheerleader.description: At the start of my turn, I can make the racers in last place move 2. If I do, I move 1.
cheerleader.notes: If several racers are tied for last, they all move, but I only move 1. If I cheer for myself, these are separate moves: move 2, then move 1.

coach.description: Everyone on my space gets +1 to their main move, including me.
coach.notes: I benefit from my own power too.

copy-cat.description: I have the power of the racer currently in the lead. If there’s a tie, I pick.
copy-cat.notes: I always have the current leader’s power, even outside my turn. In a conflict, the original racer’s power takes priority. I never copy “before my race” powers. If the lead is tied, I cannot change my chosen power in the middle of an action.

dicemonger.description: Anyone can reroll their main move once per turn. When another racer does it, I move 1.
dicemonger.notes: When someone else rerolls, I move before they move.

duelist.description: Whenever a racer shares my space, I can shout DUEL! We roll our dice and whoever rolls highest moves 2. I win ties.
duelist.notes: I can duel multiple times per turn, even outside my turn, whenever I share a space. I cannot interrupt an action in progress, such as between a roll and a move.

egg.description: Before my race, draw 3 new racers from the deck and pick one. I have its powers.
egg.notes: Keep using my racer token. I also get the chosen racer’s “before my race” powers.

flip-flop.description: I can skip rolling for my main move and swap spaces with another racer instead.
flip-flop.notes: Swapping is a warp, not a move, and I do not roll. We swap simultaneously, so I never share a space with the racer I swap with.

genius.description: I can predict what number I’ll roll for my main move. If I’m right, I take an extra turn.
genius.notes: If I correctly predict a 1 while racing against Skipper, Skipper takes the next turn because their power triggers after mine. If I control multiple racers, the extra turn is only for Genius.

gunk.description: Other racers get -1 to their main move.
gunk.notes: This reduces the move amount, not the die result. A 6 does not become a 5, so Lackey’s power still triggers.

hare.description: I get +2 to my main move. When I start my turn alone in the lead, I skip my main move.

heckler.description: When a racer ends their turn within 1 space of where they started, I move 2.
heckler.notes: My power also works for racers spending their turn recovering from tripping.

huge-baby.description: No one can ever be on my space, besides the Start. Whenever that would happen, put the racer on the space behind me instead.
huge-baby.notes: Placing a racer behind me is not a move; they are treated as having stopped there. If I stop on Banana’s space and put them behind me, that counts as passing Banana, so I trip.

hypnotist.description: At the start of my turn, I can warp a racer to my space.

inchworm.description: When another racer rolls a 1 for their main move, they skip that move and I move 1.
inchworm.notes: If another racer rolls a 1 with Skipper on the track, I move 1 first, then Skipper takes their turn.

lackey.description: When another racer rolls a 6 for their main move, I move 2.
lackey.notes: If the order matters, I move before the other racer.

leaptoad.description: I skip spaces with other  racers on them.
leaptoad.notes: I skip occupied spaces even when moving backwards.

legs.description: I can skip rolling for my main move and move 5 instead.
legs.notes: This counts as my main move, so Gunk can reduce it and Coach can increase it.

loveable-loser.description: At the start of my turn, I get 1 point chip if I'm alone in last place.

magician.description: I can reroll my main move up to two times.
magician.notes: I must use my last roll.

mastermind.description: At the start of my first turn, I predict which racer will win. If I’m right, the race ends immediately and I finish 2nd.
mastermind.notes: If I predict myself, I can take both 1st and 2nd place.

mouth.description: When I stop on a space with exactly one other racer, they’re eliminated from the race.

party-animal.description: At the start of my turn, all racers move 1 space towards me. Each other racer on my space gives me +1 to my main move.
party-animal.notes: If Huge Baby moves onto my space through this power, everyone there is placed 1 space behind them.

rocket-scientist.description: I can double my main move roll. When I do, I trip.
rocket-scientist.notes: I roll first, then decide whether to use my power.

romantic.description: When anyone stops on a space with exactly one other racer, I move 2.
romantic.notes: My power does not trigger if two racers move together simultaneously, as with Party Animal or Suckerfish.

scoocher.description: When another racer’s power happens, I move 1.
scoocher.notes: With Gunk, I move 1 for every −1 applied to a racer’s main move. With Dicemonger, I move for each reroll. With Leaptoad, I move 1 for each skipped space: two consecutive occupied spaces mean two separate moves of 1. I also move for each Magician reroll, even if its result is not used.

sisyphus.description: Before my race, I take 4 point chips. When I roll a 6 for my main move, instead of moving, I warp to the Start and lose 1 point chip.
sisyphus.notes: After more than four rolls of 6, I keep losing points as long as I have any. I do not take my main move after warping to Start.

skipper.description: When anyone rolls a 1 for their main move, I go next in turn order.
skipper.notes: After my turn, turn order continues to my left, unless I roll a 1 and go again!

stickler.description: Other racers can only cross the finish line by moving the exact amount they need. If they overshoot, they don’t move.
stickler.notes: This applies to all movement, including main moves and powers. For example, Duelist cannot cross the finish line by winning a duel from the last space before the line.

suckerfish.description: When a racer starts a move on my space, I can move with them.
suckerfish.notes: Once I start moving with a racer, I must stay with them for their entire move. I can cross the finish line with this power. We arrive simultaneously, but the racer I follow resolves first for finishing and triggering powers.

third-wheel.description: At the start of my turn, I can warp to any space with exactly 2 racers on it.
third-wheel.notes: I still take my main move after warping.

twin.description: Before my race, I can pick a racer who won a previous race and race with their powers.
twin.notes: Keep using my racer token. I also get the chosen racer’s “before my race” powers.
